logistic_regression.description: Scaled logistic regression; class-balanced binary candidate scoring.
logistic_regression.strengths: Fast inference, transparent feature effects, and a well-defined candidate probability.
logistic_regression.limitations: A linear decision boundary may miss interactions between heading, geometry, and speed; balanced fitting can affect probability calibration.

gaussian_nb.description: Gaussian Naive Bayes over candidate geometry/motion features.
gaussian_nb.objective: maximum likelihood under class-conditional Gaussian features
gaussian_nb.strengths: Very fast to train and score; produces probabilities with little tuning.
gaussian_nb.limitations: Conditional independence and Gaussian feature assumptions are restrictive for correlated road geometry and motion features.

decision_tree.description: Shallow CART tree with balanced classes to limit majority-class bias.
decision_tree.strengths: Captures nonlinear thresholds and is easy to inspect.
decision_tree.limitations: A single tree can be unstable and can overfit local candidate patterns.

extra_trees.description: Extremely randomized trees with balanced bootstrap samples.
extra_trees.strengths: Captures nonlinear interactions and reduces single-tree variance.
extra_trees.limitations: Larger model and slower scoring than linear/probabilistic baselines; raw probabilities may need calibration.

hist_gradient_boosting.description: Histogram gradient boosting with shallow leaves and regularization.
hist_gradient_boosting.strengths: Captures nonlinear feature interactions with regularized additive trees.
hist_gradient_boosting.limitations: More costly to fit and tune; learned candidate scores still need a sequential decoder for route coherence.

bayesian_search_space: max_leaf_nodes: integer [7, 31]; learning_rate: log-uniform [0.025, 0.2]; l2_regularization: log-uniform [1e-4, 10]
decoder_selection_rule: Maximize route continuity subject to no more than a 0.03 Top-1 accuracy drop from independent candidate ranking, using student-test development data.
